text:
emily_cs: Hey team — Sable Finance (trial) needs an APAC demo window tomorrow + short-term QPS lift and IP allowlist so their integration tests don't hit our rate limits. Renewal health looks high risk if demo fails :grimacing:
emily_cs: Requesting temporary CIDR add + header allowlist + raise to 120 QPS for 3 hours (09:00-12:00 SGT).
emily_cs: Details: env=staging, customer_id=sable-fin, reason=partner-demo, renewal_flag=escalated
raj_ops: Can you drop the CIDRs and exact window? Also want to confirm whether this should be an IP allowlist or header-based bypass.
emily_cs: CIDR: 203.0.113.0/28 and 198.51.100.16/28. Window: 2026-03-25 09:00 SGT -> 2026-03-25 12:00 SGT. Prefer IP allowlist + X-Org header fallback.
taylor_net: I can do the peering/egress rule update. Need ticket created in net-provisioning. I'll also warm KV cache before the window to avoid cold-start token surge.
taylor_net: Proposed config snippet:
```
allowlist: ["203.0.113.0/28","198.51.100.16/28"]
header_allow: "X-Partner-Sable"
qps_limit: 120
schedule: 2026-03-25T01:00Z -> 2026-03-25T04:00Z
```
lucas_se: Quick note: their integration uses streaming so keep max_tokens_per_request sane. Suggest max_tokens=512 and set prefix_cache_ttl=900s to reduce repeated prefix compute.
lucas_se: Also flag for ops: enable canary fallback to smaller model if latency spikes.
raj_ops: Thanks — I'll file the net-provisioning ticket and ops change. Approvers? This is above self-serve so need sign-off from CS lead.
emily_cs: CS lead @monica_cs already verbally approved last call. I'll add her to the ticket for audit.
config-bot: Scheduled change queued: net-provisioning#8421, ops-change#5420. ETA to apply configs: 2026-03-25 00:50Z for pre-warm, 2026-03-25 01:55Z for final switch.
taylor_net: I'll perform KV warmup script at 00:50Z and monitor latency. If 99th p90 > 400ms, we'll auto-toggle to canary model as Lucas suggested.
raj_ops: Ticket created and linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NET-8421. Ops change linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-5420. Adding labels: customer-onboard, temp-qps, apac.
emily_cs: Noted. I'll send Sable a confirmation email with the window and expected behavior.
config-bot: Change applied: allowlist updated for staging on 2026-03-25T00:55:12Z (pre-warm). QPS bump scheduled for 2026-03-25T01:00:00Z.
taylor_net: Confirmed final switch at 01:55Z completed. Observability shows steady token rate and no errors.
emily_cs: Amazing — thanks all! I'll follow up post-demo with feedback and renewal update. :tada:
